spans.s: यशः-काय, m. a body consisting of glory, i. e. glory,
+ पटह यशस्- + पटह, m. a drum.
+ प्राण यष्टि- + प्राण, adj. out of breath, Johns.

यशस् (for original दशस् = Lat. decus, from a lost vb. दश्, see below),
 I. n.
 1. Glory,

= Rigv. vii. 16, 4.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. decere, docere; δοκέω, δόξω, δόγμα, δοκεύω, διδάσκω, δάκτυλος; probably A.S. ta, tah; O.H.G. zêha.

यशस्-कर,
 I. adj., f. री, Rendering famous, Hit. iii. d. 122.
 II. m. A proper name,
यशस् + वन्त्, adj., f. वाति, and युअशस्विन् यशस् + विन्, adj., f. विनी, Famous,

यष्टि,
 I. m. and f. (and यष्टी यष्टी, f.),
 1. A staff, a stick, Pañc. 105, 19; 261, 12; Śiś. 9, 39; a perch, Vikr. d. 43; a stem, d. 44; support,

. A string, Vikr. d. 51.
 5. A necklace.
 6. Any creeping plant, Utt.

. A shrub, Siponanthus indica.
 II. m.
 1. A flagstaff.
 2. The arm and forearm.
 --Comp.

यष्टि + क,
 I. m. A bird, the lapwing.
 II. f. का.
 1. A staff, a club.
 2. A necklace.
 3. A pond.
 4. Liquorice.
याष्टीक, i. e. यष्टी + क, m. A warrior armed with a club.
यष्टुकाम, i. e. यष्टुम् (infin. of यज्), -काम, adj. Desiring to sacrifice,
यष्टृ, i. e. यज् + तृ, m. A sacrificer.

यस् (akin to यम्, for यंस्), i. 4, and † 1, Par. To make strenuous and persevering exertion, to endeavour.
 --With the prep. आ आ,
 1. To endeavour,

. To be afflicted, Bhaṭṭ. 6, 69. आयस्त,
 1. Pained, distressed,

. Strained, Pañc. v. d. 28.
 --Caus. To torment,

(Prākṛ.).
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अन्-आयासित, Not practised, Pañc. i. d. 429 (rather अन्-आयास + इत).
 --With प्र प्र, To endeavour, Naiṣ. 1, 125. प्रयस्त. Seasoned, dressed with condiments.
+ राशि यशस्- + राशि, m. greatness of glory, i. e. a glorious deed,
